serviceComponent.desClusterNotCorrelateNode: The destination is a cluster, Instana could not correlate this call to any specific nodes.
serviceComponent.sourceUnmonitored: The source of this call has not been traced and as a result no information can be provided about the source. All information shown about this call is provided by the destination.
serviceComponent.sourceMonitoredByAnotherProvider: The source of this call is traced by another distributed tracing provider. You can find more information on the source by searching the parent span within that provider with id {{foreignParentId}}.

summary.duplicateCallsDesc: This trace consists of one or more duplicate calls (spans). Unique Calls: {{traceCallCountIgnoringBatchSize}} - Records: {{traceCallRecordCount}}. This leads to incorrect call count (with batches) and error count values, and perhaps other irregularities.
summary.traceIngestionBatchCount: This trace got processed in {{traceIngestionBatchesCount}} batches. That may cause irregularities such as spans not getting merged to a single Call, partial Service mapping or other incomplete data showing.
summary.largeTraceLink: This trace is large and rendering of this trace can result in performance problems within your browser. You can either <linkToDocs>download the trace</linkToDocs> for manual inspection or attempt trace rendering within your browser. We will only render a subset of the components in order to increase performance of this attempt.
